entries.title: First run
entries.summary: The first-run wizard sets your nickname, identity, appearance, server, TLS and optional SASL.
entries.body: The first-run wizard sets your nickname, identity, appearance, server, TLS and optional SASL. Reopen it from Interface settings.
entries.note: Server rules determine whether a nickname or authentication is accepted.

entries.title: Manage networks
entries.summary: Configure several servers, their ports, TLS, SASL and auto-join channels; reorder networks and use the left drawer to switch.
entries.body: Configure several servers, their ports, TLS, SASL and auto-join channels; reorder networks and use the left drawer to switch.
entries.note: Networks have different connection rules.

entries.title: TLS and SASL
entries.summary: TLS encrypts the client-server connection; SASL authenticates your IRC account.
entries.body: TLS encrypts the client-server connection; SASL authenticates your IRC account. Configure them separately on the server screen.
entries.note: TLS does not provide end-to-end message encryption.

entries.title: Conversation navigation
entries.summary: The left drawer lists networks, channels and private chats; the top conversation strip offers quick switching.
entries.body: The left drawer lists networks, channels and private chats; the top conversation strip offers quick switching. Unread and mention counters are separate.

entries.title: Private chats (PVT)
entries.summary: Open user details or a private chat from a nickname.
entries.body: Open user details or a private chat from a nickname. PVT toolbar shortcuts include sharing, ignore, and closing the conversation.
entries.note: PVTs are not end-to-end encrypted by default.

entries.title: Autocompletion
entries.summary: The composer suggests nicknames, channels and commands.
entries.body: The composer suggests nicknames, channels and commands. Selecting a suggestion can complete a nickname in the current draft.

entries.title: Nickname gestures
entries.summary: On nickname spans, tap and long-press keep their configured actions.
entries.body: On nickname spans, tap and long-press keep their configured actions. Channel swipes default to right=mention and left=WHOIS; PVT swipes to right=copy and left=WHOIS.
entries.note: Swipe directions can be customized in Interface settings.

entries.title: WHOIS and WHOWAS views
entries.summary: Use structured user information screens to view replies from WHOIS and WHOWAS instead of reading raw numerics.
entries.body: Use structured user information screens to view replies from WHOIS and WHOWAS instead of reading raw numerics.
entries.note: Information depends on server privacy policies.

entries.title: User and channel modes
entries.summary: Mode editors display available user and channel modes and explain them where server capabilities are known.
entries.body: Mode editors display available user and channel modes and explain them where server capabilities are known.
entries.note: Changing modes requires adequate privileges.

entries.title: Ban and exception lists
entries.summary: Read and edit channel bans and exceptions from the dedicated moderation interface when you have permission.
entries.body: Read and edit channel bans and exceptions from the dedicated moderation interface when you have permission.
entries.note: Extended ban masks depend on the IRC daemon.

entries.title: Ignore list
entries.summary: Use Ignore to filter local messages by nickname or mask.
entries.body: Use Ignore to filter local messages by nickname or mask. It is not equivalent to a server-side ban.
entries.note: Review a mask in its dialog before saving.

entries.title: Monitored users
entries.summary: The Monitored users screen follows nicknames' online/offline changes via the MONITOR extension on compatible servers.
entries.body: The Monitored users screen follows nicknames' online/offline changes via the MONITOR extension on compatible servers.
entries.note: Requires MONITOR support advertised by the server.

entries.title: Caller-ID +g and ACCEPT
entries.summary: On supporting networks, caller-ID +g restricts incoming PVTs and ACCEPT authorizes nicknames.
entries.body: On supporting networks, caller-ID +g restricts incoming PVTs and ACCEPT authorizes nicknames. TIARCA can authorize a contact when you start a PVT.
entries.note: Not available on every IRC server.

entries.title: Mentions and search
entries.summary: Use mention navigation and chat history search to find a message in context.
entries.body: Use mention navigation and chat history search to find a message in context. The selected mention is highlighted in the conversation.
entries.note: Only locally available history is searchable.

entries.title: Themes and graphic presets
entries.summary: A theme sets light/dark colors; a preset additionally configures fonts, message format, timestamps and avatars.
entries.body: A theme sets light/dark colors; a preset additionally configures fonts, message format, timestamps and avatars. Export portable .ircpreset files.
entries.note: Manual visual changes switch to Custom.

entries.title: Quick commands and aliases
entries.summary: Configure short commands such as !wiki, !yt, !calc and !movie, and IRC slash-command aliases in settings.
entries.body: Configure short commands such as !wiki, !yt, !calc and !movie, and IRC slash-command aliases in settings.
entries.note: These are not general-purpose plugins or scripts.

entries.title: File and media sharing
entries.summary: Share supported images, video and files through uploaded links inserted in a chat.
entries.body: Share supported images, video and files through uploaded links inserted in a chat.
entries.note: Links sent to a channel may be accessible to other people.

entries.title: Backup and restore
entries.summary: Export and restore your settings, configurations and preferences with TIARCA's backup interface.
entries.body: Export and restore your settings, configurations and preferences with TIARCA's backup interface.
entries.note: Backups may contain sensitive data; store them securely.

entries.title: Diagnostic logs
entries.summary: Enable diagnostic logging when troubleshooting, then share redacted details and reproducible steps.
entries.body: Enable diagnostic logging when troubleshooting, then share redacted details and reproducible steps.
entries.note: Do not expose credentials, private chats or identifying addresses.

entries.title: JOIN
entries.summary: Join the specified channel, optionally with a key after the channel name.
entries.body: Join the specified channel, optionally with a key after the channel name.
entries.note: Access can be denied by bans, invite-only modes or a wrong key.

entries.title: PART
entries.summary: Leave one channel without disconnecting from the entire network.
entries.body: Leave one channel without disconnecting from the entire network.

entries.title: NICK
entries.summary: Request a nickname change; the server can refuse occupied or invalid nicknames.
entries.body: Request a nickname change; the server can refuse occupied or invalid nicknames.

entries.title: MSG / PRIVMSG
entries.summary: Send a private message to the specified nickname, or target a channel.
entries.body: Send a private message to the specified nickname, or target a channel.
entries.note: Always check the recipient.

entries.title: ME / ACTION
entries.summary: Send a CTCP ACTION to the current conversation, displayed as an action.
entries.body: Send a CTCP ACTION to the current conversation, displayed as an action.

entries.title: WHOIS
entries.summary: Request server-provided information about a nickname, such as account and visible channels.
entries.body: Request server-provided information about a nickname, such as account and visible channels.
entries.note: Results depend on privacy settings.

entries.title: WHOWAS
entries.summary: Query recent server history for a nickname that has disappeared or changed.
entries.body: Query recent server history for a nickname that has disappeared or changed.
entries.note: Older entries may be unavailable.

entries.title: AWAY
entries.summary: Mark yourself as absent with a message; /away alone generally clears it.
entries.body: Mark yourself as absent with a message; /away alone generally clears it.

entries.title: QUIT
entries.summary: Disconnect cleanly from the IRC server and leave all its channels.
entries.body: Disconnect cleanly from the IRC server and leave all its channels.

entries.title: LIST
entries.summary: Ask the server for the visible channel list; TIARCA also has a channel-list interface.
entries.body: Ask the server for the visible channel list; TIARCA also has a channel-list interface.
entries.note: Some networks require authentication or impose delays.

entries.title: NAMES
entries.summary: Show the visible nicknames in a channel, often with role prefixes.
entries.body: Show the visible nicknames in a channel, often with role prefixes.

entries.title: TOPIC
entries.summary: Read or request a topic change for a channel.
entries.body: Read or request a topic change for a channel.
entries.note: With +t, a channel operator may be required.

entries.title: INVITE
entries.summary: Send an invitation to a user; it does not force them to join.
entries.body: Send an invitation to a user; it does not force them to join.

entries.title: MOTD
entries.summary: Read the network message of the day, often including rules and notices.
entries.body: Read the network message of the day, often including rules and notices.

entries.title: VERSION
entries.summary: Ask for the server implementation/version details that it publishes.
entries.body: Ask for the server implementation/version details that it publishes.

entries.title: TIME
entries.summary: Ask the server for its time, possibly in a different timezone.
entries.body: Ask the server for its time, possibly in a different timezone.

entries.title: ISON
entries.summary: Query which of the listed nicknames are currently online.
entries.body: Query which of the listed nicknames are currently online.

entries.title: RAW / QUOTE
entries.summary: Send a protocol command directly to the server.
entries.body: Send a protocol command directly to the server. TIARCA supports /raw and /quote aliases.
entries.note: Never run unknown raw commands; malformed requests can disconnect you.

entries.title: Channel MODE
entries.summary: Read or modify channel modes governing speech, access and moderation.
entries.body: Read or modify channel modes governing speech, access and moderation.
entries.note: Changing modes normally requires privileges.

entries.title: Operator (+o/-o)
entries.summary: Grant channel operator using +o and remove it using -o.
entries.body: Grant channel operator using +o and remove it using -o.
entries.note: Channel operator is not network IRC operator.

entries.title: Voice (+v/-v)
entries.summary: Give a member voice so they can usually speak in a +m moderated channel.
entries.body: Give a member voice so they can usually speak in a +m moderated channel.

entries.title: KICK
entries.summary: Remove a user from the channel, optionally specifying a reason.
entries.body: Remove a user from the channel, optionally specifying a reason.
entries.note: A kick alone does not prevent re-entry.

entries.title: Ban by mask (+b)
entries.summary: Ban a matching nickname, ident or hostmask.
entries.body: Ban a matching nickname, ident or hostmask. Typical masks resemble nick!user@host and may include * wildcards.
entries.note: Broad masks can affect innocent users.

entries.title: Remove ban (-b)
entries.summary: Remove an existing ban by giving the same mask as the ban entry.
entries.body: Remove an existing ban by giving the same mask as the ban entry.

entries.title: Read ban list
entries.summary: Request the current ban list from the server; TIARCA can show it in a dedicated interface.
entries.body: Request the current ban list from the server; TIARCA can show it in a dedicated interface.

entries.title: Ban exception (+e)
entries.summary: Exclude a matching hostmask from normal channel bans when the server supports +e.
entries.body: Exclude a matching hostmask from normal channel bans when the server supports +e.

entries.title: Invite exception (+I)
entries.summary: Permit matching users to join an invite-only channel without a personal invitation on compatible servers.
entries.body: Permit matching users to join an invite-only channel without a personal invitation on compatible servers.

entries.title: Invite-only (+i)
entries.summary: Make channel entry require invitations; not the same as user mode +i.
entries.body: Make channel entry require invitations; not the same as user mode +i.

entries.title: Moderated (+m)
entries.summary: Restrict channel messages typically to voice users or operators.
entries.body: Restrict channel messages typically to voice users or operators.

entries.title: Protected topic (+t)
entries.summary: Restrict who can change a channel's topic, often to operators.
entries.body: Restrict who can change a channel's topic, often to operators.

entries.title: No external messages (+n)
entries.summary: Prevent people who have not joined from sending channel messages.
entries.body: Prevent people who have not joined from sending channel messages.

entries.title: Channel key (+k)
entries.summary: Set a key required when joining the channel.
entries.body: Set a key required when joining the channel.
entries.note: Do not publish private channel keys.

entries.title: Channel limit (+l)
entries.summary: Limit the number of people who can join a channel.
entries.body: Limit the number of people who can join a channel.

entries.title: Invisible user mode (+i)
entries.summary: Hide from broad WHO queries by users who do not share a channel with you.
entries.body: Hide from broad WHO queries by users who do not share a channel with you.
entries.note: Does not hide you from the server.

entries.title: WHO
entries.summary: Query visible users matching a channel, nickname or mask; the server can filter results.
entries.body: Query visible users matching a channel, nickname or mask; the server can filter results.

entries.title: USERHOST
entries.summary: Request compact host and user details permitted by the server.
entries.body: Request compact host and user details permitted by the server.

entries.title: STATS
entries.summary: Request server statistics by query letter.
entries.body: Request server statistics by query letter. Many responses require IRC operator privileges.

entries.title: LINKS
entries.summary: Request visible server links and network topology.
entries.body: Request visible server links and network topology.
entries.note: Many networks hide this information.

entries.title: LUSERS
entries.summary: Obtain a server-reported snapshot of users, operators and servers.
entries.body: Obtain a server-reported snapshot of users, operators and servers.

entries.title: ADMIN
entries.summary: Request public administrator contact information maintained by the server.
entries.body: Request public administrator contact information maintained by the server.

entries.title: INFO
entries.summary: Request explanatory information published by the IRC server.
entries.body: Request explanatory information published by the IRC server.

entries.title: KNOCK
entries.summary: Request an invite to a restricted channel on servers supporting KNOCK.
entries.body: Request an invite to a restricted channel on servers supporting KNOCK.
entries.note: Not a universal IRC command.

entries.title: MONITOR (IRCv3)
entries.summary: Subscribe to online/offline changes.
entries.body: Subscribe to online/offline changes. MONITOR + adds, - removes, L lists, S checks status and C clears.
entries.note: Use TIARCA's user-monitor UI when possible; server must advertise MONITOR.

entries.title: Account extended bans
entries.summary: IRCv3 ACCOUNTEXTBAN advertises account-ban types.
entries.body: IRCv3 ACCOUNTEXTBAN advertises account-ban types. $R:account works only where that syntax is advertised; other servers use another form.
entries.note: Check EXTBAN and ACCOUNTEXTBAN in ISUPPORT before applying.

entries.title: ACCEPT and caller-ID
entries.summary: Where supported, /accept +nick permits a user to message you under caller-ID +g; /accept -nick removes permission.
entries.body: Where supported, /accept +nick permits a user to message you under caller-ID +g; /accept -nick removes permission.
entries.note: Not supported on every network.

entries.title: NickServ
entries.summary: Many networks have a NickServ service for account registration and authentication.
entries.body: Many networks have a NickServ service for account registration and authentication. Ask it for HELP before using network-specific commands.
entries.note: NickServ is not a core IRC command; never reveal account passwords.

entries.title: ChanServ
entries.summary: Some networks offer ChanServ to manage registered channels, access lists and permissions.
entries.body: Some networks offer ChanServ to manage registered channels, access lists and permissions. Request HELP for correct syntax.
entries.note: The service may be absent or named differently.

entries.title: IRCv3 extensions
entries.summary: Optional specifications include SASL, server-time, multi-prefix and message tags.
entries.body: Optional specifications include SASL, server-time, multi-prefix and message tags. The server and client negotiate actual support.
entries.note: Do not issue arbitrary CAP commands in a live session.
